contentBlocks.body: A variable gives a value a name so the program can reuse it. Prefer const when the binding will not be reassigned.
The value can still be an object or array that changes; const protects the binding, not every nested value.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Which declaration should you usually choose for a binding that will not be reassigned?

payload.explanation: const communicates that the binding itself should stay attached to the same value.

payload.text: A variable gives a value a ____ so it can be reused later.
